Drop.title: Drop a receipt
Drop.body:
A one-time link your agent made for a booking opens this page. Drop exactly one receipt, as a PDF or an image. TILL attaches it to the booking and keeps it as the law requires.

If the link belongs to a proposal, the receipt waits until you approve it. If you reject the proposal, the receipt is deleted.

Each link works once and expires after the time set in the settings. Your agent makes a new one.
